evidence: This claim is supported by a citation to Fan et al., 2011.

claim: The BATS domain can act as an autonomous membrane-interacting module that confers gain of function to VPS34 activity.

Increasing acyl chain unsaturation for substrate and non-substrate lipids in detergent micelles activates phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate 5-kinase isoforms (Shulga et al., 2012).
